raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "0.7.9"
  build_number: 8
  torch_proc_type: ${{ "cpu" if cuda_compiler_version == "None" else "cuda" }}
  build_prefix: ${{ "cpu_" if cuda_compiler_version == "None" else "cuda" ~ (cuda_compiler_version | replace(".", "")) }}

package:
  name: pytorch3d
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/facebookresearch/pytorch3d/archive/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 96c1ef357c522e1f45b5f9c27bae9b75185034457ddbcacdd343a0ec50bc515f
  patches:
    - if: match(cuda_compiler_version, "13.*")
      then: cuda-13-support.patch

build:
  number: ${{ build_number }}
  string: ${{ build_prefix ~ "py" ~ (python | version_to_buildstring) ~ "h" ~ hash ~ "_" ~ build_number }}
  script:
    - if: linux and cuda_compiler_version != "None"
      then: export CC="${GCC}"
    - if: linux and cuda_compiler_version != "None"
      then: export NVCC_FLAGS="--compiler-bindir=${CC}"
    # Keep this aligned with the architectures supported by conda-forge's PyTorch builds.
    - if: linux and match(cuda_compiler_version, "12.*")
      then: export TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST="5.0;6.0;7.0;7.5;8.0;8.6;9.0;10.0;12.0+PTX"
    - if: win and match(cuda_compiler_version, "12.*")
      then: set "TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST=5.0;6.0;7.0;7.5;8.0;8.6;9.0+PTX"
    - if: unix and match(cuda_compiler_version, "13.*")
      then: export TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST="7.5;8.0;8.6;9.0;10.0;12.0+PTX"
    - if: win and match(cuda_compiler_version, "13.*")
      then: set "TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST=7.5;8.0;8.6;9.0;10.0;12.0+PTX"
    - if: unix and cuda_compiler_version != "None"
      then: export FORCE_CUDA=1
    - if: win and cuda_compiler_version != "None"
      then: set "FORCE_CUDA=1"
    - python -m pip install . --no-deps --no-build-isolation -vv
  dynamic_linking:
    # PyTorch installs these libraries in a nonstandard location.
    missing_dso_allowlist:
      - "*/libc10${{ SHLIB_EXT }}"
      - "*/libc10_cuda${{ SHLIB_EXT }}"
      - "*/libtorch${{ SHLIB_EXT }}"
      - "*/libtorch_cpu${{ SHLIB_EXT }}"
      - "*/libtorch_cuda${{ SHLIB_EXT }}"
      - "*/libtorch_python${{ SHLIB_EXT }}"

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
    - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
    - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None"
      then: ${{ compiler('cuda') }}
    - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None"
      then: cuda-version ==${{ cuda_compiler_version }}
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - numpy
        - pytorch
        - pytorch * ${{ torch_proc_type }}*
    - if: build_platform != target_platform and cuda_compiler_version != "None"
      then:
        - libcusparse-dev
        - libcusolver-dev
        - libcublas-dev
  host:
    - python
    - pip
    - setuptools
    - numpy
    - pytorch
    - pytorch * ${{ torch_proc_type }}*
    - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None"
      then:
        - cudnn
        - cuda-cccl
        - libcusparse-dev
        - libcusolver-dev
        - libcublas-dev
        - cuda-version ==${{ cuda_compiler_version }}
  run:
    - python
    - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None"
      then:
        - ${{ pin_compatible('cudnn') }}
        - cuda-cudart
        - __cuda
    - torchvision
    - fvcore
    - iopath
  run_constraints:
    # Add the CPU/GPU flavor constraint alongside PyTorch's version run export.
    - pytorch * ${{ torch_proc_type }}*

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - pytorch3d
      pip_check: true
  - script:
      - python -c "from pytorch3d import _C; assert _C is not None"

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/facebookresearch/pytorch3d
  repository: https://github.com/facebookresearch/pytorch3d
  summary: 3D geometry for PyTorch
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_file: LICENSE

extra:
  feedstock-name: pytorch3d
  recipe-maintainers:
    - Tobias-Fischer
    - weiji14
